```h
#pragma once
#include "mono/hooklib.h"
#include "mono/mono.h"
#include "../../Includes.h"
#include "c_player.hpp"
#include "unity.hpp"

namespace define
{
	// rewritten dumbhook, this is sigged. u will need to change it! - chloe

	class jit_hook_c
	{
	private:
		std::uintptr_t m_original{ 0 };
		std::uint8_t* old_instructions{ 0 };
		std::uint8_t* new_instructions{ 0 };
	public:
		auto hook_fn(std::uintptr_t target_function, void* our_function) -> const bool
		{
			unsigned char* _ptr = (unsigned char*)target_function;

			_ptr[0] = 0x48;
			_ptr[1] = 0xB8;
			*(void**)(_ptr + 2) = our_function;
			_ptr[10] = 0xFF;
			_ptr[11] = 0xE0;

			return true;
		}

		auto setup(std::string name, void* our_function, int arg_count = -1) -> bool
		{
			auto jit_func_ptr = mono_lib::method(name, arg_count);
			if (!jit_func_ptr)
				return false;

			constexpr static auto hook_size = 12;

			old_instructions = new std::uint8_t[hook_size];

			chloe::crt::memory::memcpy(old_instructions, reinterpret_cast<void*>(jit_func_ptr), hook_size);
			this->m_original = jit_func_ptr;

			if (!hook_fn(jit_func_ptr, our_function))
			{
				old_instructions = nullptr;
				return false;
			}

			new_instructions = new std::uint8_t[hook_size];
			chloe::crt::memory::memcpy(new_instructions, reinterpret_cast<void*>(jit_func_ptr), hook_size);

			return true;
		}

		auto setup(std::uintptr_t target_function, void* our_function) -> bool
		{
			constexpr static auto hook_size = 12;

			old_instructions = new std::uint8_t[hook_size];

			chloe::crt::memory::memcpy(old_instructions, reinterpret_cast<void*>(target_function), hook_size);
			this->m_original = target_function;

			if (!hook_fn(target_function, our_function))
			{
				old_instructions = nullptr;
				return false;
			}

			new_instructions = new std::uint8_t[hook_size];
			chloe::crt::memory::memcpy(new_instructions, reinterpret_cast<void*>(target_function), hook_size);

			return true;
		}

		auto setup(const char* name_space, const char* klass_name, const char* method_name, void* our_function, int arg_count = -1) -> bool
		{
			auto jit_func_ptr = mono_lib::method(name_space, klass_name, method_name, arg_count);
			if (!jit_func_ptr)
				return false;

			constexpr static auto hook_size = 12;

			old_instructions = new std::uint8_t[hook_size];

			chloe::crt::memory::memcpy(old_instructions, reinterpret_cast<void*>(jit_func_ptr), hook_size);
			this->m_original = jit_func_ptr;

			if (!hook_fn(jit_func_ptr, our_function))
			{
				old_instructions = nullptr;
				return false;
			}

			new_instructions = new std::uint8_t[hook_size];
			chloe::crt::memory::memcpy(new_instructions, reinterpret_cast<void*>(jit_func_ptr), hook_size);

			return true;
		}

		bool toggle_hook(bool unhook)
		{
			if (!this->m_original || !new_instructions)
				return false;

			constexpr static auto hook_size = 12;

			auto jit_func_ptr = reinterpret_cast<std::uint8_t*>(this->m_original);
			auto instructions = unhook ? this->old_instructions : this->new_instructions;

			chloe::crt::memory::memcpy(jit_func_ptr, instructions, hook_size);

			return true;
		}

		template< typename type >
		auto get_original() -> type
		{
			return reinterpret_cast<type>(m_original);
		}
	};
}

#define JIT_FN( type, name, args ) inline define::jit_hook_c name; type hk_##name args;

namespace impl
{
	namespace hooks
	{

		JIT_FN(void, gui_controller_ongui, (void* instacne));
		JIT_FN(void, gui_controller_start, (void* instance));
		JIT_FN(void, gui_controller_update, (void* instacne));
	}
}
```

```h
struct Ray
{
	Vector3 Origin;
	Vector3 direction;

	Ray(Vector3 origin, Vector3 direction)
	{
		this->Origin = origin;
		this->direction = direction;
		this->direction = direction.Normalize();
	}
};

bool Visible(Vector3 pos1, Vector3 pos2)
{
	MONO_METHOD(raycast, "UnityEngine::PhysicsScene.Internal_RaycastTest_Injected()", -1, bool(*)(uint32_t*, Ray*, float*, unsigned int, int));
	if (raycast)
	{
		Vector3 direction = pos1 - pos2;
		float distance = direction.Magnitude() * 0.9f;
		auto ray = Ray(pos2, direction);

		uint32_t sceneHandle = 0;
		return !raycast(&sceneHandle, &ray, &distance, 0x0000180, 0);
	}
	else
		return false;
}

bool SDK::ReadMatrix()
{
	uint64_t temp = this->offsets.fpsCamera;
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)temp))
		return false;

	temp = mem->Read<uint64_t>(temp + 0x30);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)temp))
		return false;

	temp = mem->Read<uint64_t>(temp + 0x18);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)temp))
		return false;
	//printf("temp: 0x%X\n", temp);

	this->mutex1.lock();
	this->viewMatrix = mem->Read<mat4x4_t>(temp + 0xDC).transpose();
	this->mutex1.unlock();

	return true;
}

std::string SDK::GetPlayerGroup(uint64_t instance)
{
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)instance))
		return "";

	uint64_t name = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x4C0);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)name))
		return "";

	uint64_t name2 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(name + 0x28);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)name2))
		return "";

	uint64_t name1 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(name2 + 0x18);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)name1))
		return "";

	int32_t nameLength = mem->Read<int32_t>(name1 + 0x10);

	std::wstring string = mem->GetUnicodeString(name1 + 0x14, nameLength);

	return std::string(string.begin(), string.end());
}

int GetCorpseType(uint64_t instance)
{
	uint64_t playerbody = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x118);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)playerbody))
		return 0;

	uint64_t playerbones = mem->Read<uint64_t>(playerbody + 0x20);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)playerbody))
		return 0;

	uint64_t player = mem->Read<uint64_t>(playerbones + 0x18);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)player))
		return 0;

	uint64_t body = mem->Read<uint64_t>(player + 0x4C0);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)body))
		return 0;

	uint64_t information = mem->Read<uint64_t>(body + 0x28);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)information))
		return 0;

	if (mem->Read<int32_t>(information + 0x5C) > 0)
	{
		if (mem->Read<int32_t>(information + 0x58) == 4)
		{
			return 665;
		}
		else
			return 664;
	}
	else
	{
		uint64_t role = mem->Read<uint64_t>(information + 0x38);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)role))
			return false;

		return mem->Read<int32_t>(role + 0x10); // return role (see below for list of possible return values
	}
}

float GetPlayerKD(uint64_t instance)
{
	uint64_t profile = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x4C0);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)profile))
		return 0.f;

	uint64_t stats = mem->Read<uint64_t>(profile + 0xE8);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)stats))
		return 0.f;

	uint64_t overallCounters = mem->Read<uint64_t>(stats + 0x18);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)overallCounters))
		return 0.f;

	uint64_t counterDict = mem->Read<uint64_t>(overallCounters + 0x10);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)counterDict))
		return 0.f;

	auto count = mem->Read<uint32_t>(counterDict + 0x40);
	if (count < 0 || count > 1000)
		return 0.f;

	auto entries = mem->Read<uint64_t>(counterDict + 0x18);

	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)entries))
		return 0.f;

	uint32_t kills(0), deaths(0);

	auto arrayBase = entries + 0x28;

	for (auto i = 0; i < count; i++)
	{
		auto key = mem->Read<uint64_t>(arrayBase + i * 0x18 + 0x18);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)key))
			continue;

		auto hash = mem->Read<uint32_t>(key + 0x18);
		auto value = mem->Read<uint64_t>(arrayBase + i * 0x18 + 0x20);

		auto keySet = mem->Read<uint64_t>(key + 0x10);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)keySet))
			continue;

		auto keySetSlots = mem->Read<uint64_t>(keySet + 0x18);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)keySetSlots))
			continue;

		auto setArrayBase = keySetSlots + 0x28;
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)setArrayBase))
			continue;

		auto first = mem->Read<uint64_t>(setArrayBase);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)first))
			continue;

		auto statName = mem->GetUnicodeString(first + 0x14, mem->Read<int>(first + 0x10));

		if (statName == L"Kills")
			kills = value;
		else if (statName == L"Deaths")
			deaths = value;

		std::string string = std::string(statName.begin(), statName.end());
	}

	return (deaths == 0) ? float(kills) : float(kills) / float(deaths);


}

std::vector<ImVec2> GetHealth(uint64_t instance)
{
	std::vector<ImVec2> bonesLocal;

	uint64_t healthController = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x4F8);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)healthController))
		return bonesLocal;

	uint64_t ukn1 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(healthController + 0x50);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)ukn1))
		return bonesLocal;

	uint64_t ukn2 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(ukn1 + 0x18);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)ukn1))
		return bonesLocal;

	int i = 0;
	while (i <= 6)
	{
		uint64_t body_part = mem->Read<uint64_t>(ukn2 + 0x30 + (i * 0x18));
		uint64_t health_container = mem->Read<uint64_t>(body_part + 0x10);

		float _health = mem->Read<float>(health_container + 0x10);
		float _health_max = mem->Read<float>(health_container + 0x14);

		bonesLocal.push_back(ImVec2{ _health, _health_max });
		i++;
	}

	return bonesLocal;
}

std::vector<EFTLoot> GetItemsInGrid(uint64_t gridsArrayPtr)
{
	std::vector<EFTLoot> outList;

	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)gridsArrayPtr))
		return outList;

	uint32_t listSize = mem->Read<uint32_t>(gridsArrayPtr + 0x18);
	if (listSize == 0)
		return outList;

	for (int i = 0; i < listSize; i++)
	{
		uint64_t ptr = mem->Read<uint64_t>(gridsArrayPtr + 0x20 + (i * 0x8));
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)ptr))
			continue;

		uint64_t gridEnumerableClass = mem->Read<uint64_t>(ptr + 0x40);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)gridEnumerableClass))
			continue;

		uint64_t itemListPtr = mem->Read<uint64_t>(gridEnumerableClass + 0x18);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)itemListPtr))
			continue;

		uint64_t childListPtr = mem->Read<uint64_t>(itemListPtr + 0x10);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)childListPtr))
			continue;

		uint32_t childListSize = mem->Read<uint32_t>(itemListPtr + 0x18);
		if (childListSize == 0)
			return outList;

		for (int x = 0; x < childListSize; x++)
		{
			uint64_t ptr = mem->Read<uint64_t>(childListPtr + 0x20 + (x * 0x8));
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)ptr))
				continue;

			EFTLoot ItemInstance;

			uint64_t childItemTemplate = mem->Read<uint64_t>(ptr + 0x40);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)childItemTemplate))
				continue;

			uint64_t childItemIdPtr = mem->Read<uint64_t>(childItemTemplate + 0x50);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)childItemIdPtr))
				continue;

			std::wstring childItemIdStr = mem->ReadUnicode(childItemIdPtr + 0x14);
			std::string name(childItemIdStr.begin(), childItemIdStr.end());

			std::string output;
			std::unordered_map<std::string, std::pair<std::string, int>>::const_iterator got = SDK::Instance()->AllItems.find(name);
			if (got != SDK::Instance()->AllItems.end())
			{
				ItemInstance.name = got->second.first;
				ItemInstance.price = got->second.second;
				ItemInstance.idd = childItemIdStr;
				ItemInstance.instance = ptr;
			}
			outList.push_back(ItemInstance);
		}
	}
	return outList;
}

std::vector<EFTLoot> PlayerInv(uint64_t instance, bool alive)
{
	std::vector<EFTLoot> lootList;
	uint64_t RootItem;

	if (alive)
	{
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)instance))
			return lootList;

		uint64_t playerInv = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x508);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)playerInv))
			return lootList;

		RootItem = mem->Read<uint64_t>(playerInv + 0xA0);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)RootItem))
			return lootList;
	}
	else
	{
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)instance))
			return lootList;

		uint64_t m_CachedPtr = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x10);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)m_CachedPtr))
			return lootList;

		uint64_t interactiveClass = mem->Read<uint64_t>(m_CachedPtr + 0x28);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)interactiveClass))
			return lootList;

		uint64_t itemOwner = mem->Read<uint64_t>(interactiveClass + 0x48);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)itemOwner))
			return lootList;

		RootItem = mem->Read<uint64_t>(itemOwner + 0xA0);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)RootItem))
			return lootList;
	}

	uint64_t listPtr = mem->Read<uint64_t>(RootItem + 0x70);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)listPtr))
		return lootList;

	uint32_t listSize = mem->Read<uint32_t>(listPtr + 0x18);
	if (listSize == 0)
		return lootList;

	for (int i = 0; i < listSize; i++)
	{
		uint64_t ptr = mem->Read<uint64_t>(listPtr + 0x20 + (i * 0x8));
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)ptr))
			continue;

		uint64_t containedItem = mem->Read<uint64_t>(ptr + 0x38);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)containedItem))
			continue;

		uint64_t slotId = mem->Read<uint64_t>(ptr + 0x10);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)slotId))
			continue;

		uint64_t itemTemplate = mem->Read<uint64_t>(containedItem + 0x40);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)itemTemplate))
			continue;

		uint64_t itemIdPtr = mem->Read<uint64_t>(itemTemplate + 0x50);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)itemIdPtr))
			continue;

		std::wstring slotIdName = mem->ReadUnicode(slotId + 0x14);
		std::wstring itemIdName = mem->ReadUnicode(itemIdPtr + 0x14);

		std::string slotIdStr(slotIdName.begin(), slotIdName.end());
		std::string itemIdStr(itemIdName.begin(), itemIdName.end());

		std::vector<EFTLoot> lootlocal;

		if (strcmp(slotIdStr.c_str(), "SecuredContainer") == 0 || strcmp(slotIdStr.c_str(), "Dogtag") == 0)
			continue;

		else if (strcmp(slotIdStr.c_str(), "Pockets") == 0)
		{
			lootlocal = GetItemsInGrid(mem->Read<uint64_t>(containedItem + 0x68));
			if (lootlocal.size() == 0)
				continue;

			for (auto e : lootlocal)
			{
				std::unordered_map<std::string, bool>::const_iterator got1 = SDK::Instance()->filteredItems.find(std::string(e.idd.begin(), e.idd.end()));
				if (got1 != SDK::Instance()->filteredItems.end())
				{
					if (got1->second)
						e.showAlways = false;
					else
						e.showAlways = false;
				}
				if (e.name != "Compass")
					lootList.push_back(e);
			}
		}
		else if (strcmp(slotIdStr.c_str(), "TacticalVest") == 0 || strcmp(slotIdStr.c_str(), "Backpack") == 0)
		{
			lootlocal = GetItemsInGrid(mem->Read<uint64_t>(containedItem + 0x68));
			if (lootlocal.size() == 0)
				continue;

			std::unordered_map<std::string, std::pair<std::string, int>>::const_iterator got = SDK::Instance()->AllItems.find(itemIdStr);
			if (got != SDK::Instance()->AllItems.end())
			{
				EFTLoot loot;
				loot.name = got->second.first;
				loot.price = got->second.second;

				std::unordered_map<std::string, bool>::const_iterator got1 = SDK::Instance()->filteredItems.find(itemIdStr);
				if (got1 != SDK::Instance()->filteredItems.end())
				{
					if (got1->second)
						loot.showAlways = false;
					else
						loot.showAlways = false;
				}

				if (loot.name != "Compass")
					lootList.push_back(loot);
			}

			for (auto e : lootlocal)
			{
				std::unordered_map<std::string, bool>::const_iterator got1 = SDK::Instance()->filteredItems.find(std::string(e.idd.begin(), e.idd.end()));
				if (got1 != SDK::Instance()->filteredItems.end())
				{
					if (got1->second)
						e.showAlways = false;
					else
						e.showAlways = false;
				}

				if (e.name != "Compass")
					lootList.push_back(e);

			}

		}
		else
		{
			if (strcmp(slotIdStr.c_str(), "Scabbard") == 0)
				continue;

			std::unordered_map<std::string, std::pair<std::string, int>>::const_iterator got = SDK::Instance()->AllItems.find(itemIdStr);
			if (got != SDK::Instance()->AllItems.end())
			{
				EFTLoot loot;
				loot.name = got->second.first;
				loot.price = got->second.second;

				if (loot.name != "Compass")
					lootList.push_back(loot);
			}
		}
	}
	return lootList;
}

uint64_t GetTransform(Memory* drv, uint64_t ent, int bone)
{
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)ent))
		return 0;

	uint64_t body = drv->Read<uint64_t>(ent + 0xA8);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)body))
		return 0;

	uint64_t body1 = drv->Read<uint64_t>(body + 0x28);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)body1))
		return 0;

	uint64_t body2 = drv->Read<uint64_t>(body1 + 0x28);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)body2))
		return 0;

	uint64_t bonetransforms = drv->Read<uint64_t>(body2 + 0x10);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)bonetransforms))
		return 0;

	uint64_t BoneValue = drv->Read<uint64_t>(bonetransforms + (0x20 + (bone * 0x8)));
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)BoneValue))
		return 0;

	return BoneValue;
}

std::string PlayerName(uint64_t instance)
{
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)instance))
		return "";

	uint64_t name = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x4C0);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)name))
		return "";

	uint64_t name2 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(name + 0x28);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)name2))
		return "";

	uint64_t name1 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(name2 + 0x10);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)name1))
		return "";

	int32_t nameLength = mem->Read<int32_t>(name1 + 0x10);

	std::wstring string = mem->GetUnicodeString(name1 + 0x14, nameLength);
	return std::string(string.begin(), string.end());
}

uint64_t tablePlayerExperience[] = {
	1000, 4017, 8432, 14256, 21477, 30023, 39936, 51204, 63723, 77563, 92713, 111881, 134674, 161139, 191417, 225194,
	262366, 302484, 345751, 391649, 440444, 492366, 547896, 609066, 675913, 748474, 826786, 910885, 1000809, 1096593, 1198275,
	1309251, 1429580, 1559321, 1698532, 1847272, 2005600, 2173575, 2351255, 2538699, 2735966, 2946585, 3170637,
	3408202, 3659361, 3924195, 4202784, 4495210, 4801553, 5121894, 5456314, 5809667, 6182063, 6573613,
	6984426, 7414613, 7864284, 8333549, 8831052, 9360623, 9928578, 10541848, 11206300, 11946977, 12789143, 13820522, 15229487, 17206065, 19706065, 22706065
};

int GetPlayerLevel(uint64_t instance)
{
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)instance))
		return 0;

	uint64_t profile = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x4C0);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)profile))
		return 0;

	uint64_t information = mem->Read<uint64_t>(profile + 0x28);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)information))
		return 0;

	uint64_t xp = mem->Read<uint64_t>(information + 0x74);

	auto resultLevel = 1;
	for (size_t currentLevel = 0; currentLevel < sizeof(tablePlayerExperience) - 1; currentLevel++)
	{
		auto currentLevelExp = tablePlayerExperience[currentLevel];

		if (xp < currentLevelExp)
		{
			resultLevel = currentLevel + 1;
			break;
		}
	}

	return resultLevel;
}

int GetEntityType(uint64_t instance)
{
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)instance))
		return 0;

	uint64_t body = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x4C0);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)body))
		return 0;

	uint64_t information = mem->Read<uint64_t>(body + 0x28);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)information))
		return 0;

	if (mem->Read<int32_t>(information + 0x5C) > 0)
	{
		if (mem->Read<int32_t>(information + 0x58) == 4)
		{
			return 665;
		}
		else
			return 664;
	}
	else
	{
		uint64_t role = mem->Read<uint64_t>(information + 0x38);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)role))
			return false;

		return mem->Read<int32_t>(role + 0x10); // return role (see below for list of possible return values
	}
}

std::string GetPlayerGroup(uint64_t instance)
{
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)instance))
		return "";

	uint64_t name = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x4C0);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)name))
		return "";

	uint64_t name2 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(name + 0x28);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)name2))
		return "";

	uint64_t name1 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(name2 + 0x18);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)name1))
		return "";

	int32_t nameLength = mem->Read<int32_t>(name1 + 0x10);

	std::wstring string = mem->GetUnicodeString(name1 + 0x14, nameLength);

	return std::string(string.begin(), string.end());
}

int GetSide(uint64_t instance)
{
	uint64_t profile = mem->Read<uint64_t>(instance + 0x4C0);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)profile))
		return 0;
	uint64_t info = mem->Read<uint64_t>(profile + 0x28);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)info))
		return 0;

	return mem->Read<int>(info + 0x58);
}

std::string GetSideName(int side)
{
	switch (side) {
	case 1:
		return "USEC";
	case 2:
		return "BEAR";
	case 4:
		return "SCAV";
	default:
		return "-";
	}
}

bool DiscoverLoot(uint64_t gameWorld)
{

	EFTLoot ItemInstance;
	EFTCorpse CorpseInstance;
	EFTContainer ContainerInstance;

	uint64_t m_lLootList = mem->Read<uint64_t>(gameWorld + 0x60); //58
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)m_lLootList))
		return 0;

	int32_t m_lLootListSize = mem->Read<int32_t>(m_lLootList + 0x18);
	if (m_lLootListSize == 0)
		return 0;

	uint64_t m_lLootListObject = mem->Read<uint64_t>(m_lLootList + 0x10);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)m_lLootListObject))
		return 0;

	std::vector<EFTLoot> items_local;
	std::vector<EFTCorpse> corpse_local;
	std::vector<EFTContainer> container_local;
	for (int i = 0; i < m_lLootListSize; i++)
	{

		uint64_t ite = mem->Read<uint64_t>(m_lLootListObject + 0x20 + (i * 0x8));
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)ite))
			continue;

		uint64_t ItemProfile = mem->Read<uint64_t>(ite + 0x10);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)ItemProfile))
			continue;

		uint64_t interactiveClass = mem->Read<uint64_t>(ItemProfile + 0x28);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)interactiveClass))
			continue;

		uint64_t gameObject = mem->Read<uint64_t>(ItemProfile + 0x30);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)gameObject))
			continue;

		uint64_t Item = mem->Read<uint64_t>(interactiveClass + 0x50);
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)Item)) {
			//Container

			uint64_t test69 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(interactiveClass + 0x10);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)test69))
				continue;

			uint64_t test2 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(test69 + 0x30);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)test2))
				continue;

			uint64_t TransformOne = mem->Read<uint64_t>(test2 + 0x30);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)TransformOne))
				continue;

			uint64_t TransformTwo = mem->Read<uint64_t>(TransformOne + 0x8);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)TransformTwo))
				continue;

			uint64_t TransformGood = mem->Read<uint64_t>(TransformTwo + 0x28);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)TransformGood))
				continue;

			//uint64_t TransformInternal = Memory::Read<uint64_t>(TransformGood + 0x10);
			//if (!IsValidPtr((void*)TransformInternal))
				//continue;

			FVector pos = IntPosition(TransformGood);

			uint64_t itemOwner = mem->Read<uint64_t>(interactiveClass + 0x108);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)itemOwner))
				continue;

			uint64_t item0 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(itemOwner + 0xA0);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)item0))
				continue;

			uint64_t grids = mem->Read<uint64_t>(item0 + 0x68);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)grids))
				continue;

			uint64_t grid = mem->Read<uint64_t>(grids + 0x20);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)grid))
				continue;

			uint64_t gridDict = mem->Read<uint64_t>(grid + 0x40);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)gridDict))
				continue;

			uint64_t dict = mem->Read<uint64_t>(gridDict + 0x10);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)dict))
				continue;

			int32_t gridCount = mem->Read<int32_t>(dict + 0x40);
			if (gridCount > 0) {
				uint64_t grid = mem->Read<uint64_t>(dict + 0x18);
				if (!IsValidPtr((void*)grid))
					continue;

				std::vector<EFTLoot> container_items;
				for (int ic = 0; ic < gridCount; ic++) {
					uint64_t insideItem = mem->Read<uint64_t>(grid + 0x28 + (ic * 0x18));
					if (!IsValidPtr((void*)insideItem))
						continue;
					uint64_t itemTemplate = mem->Read<uint64_t>(insideItem + 0x40);
					if (!IsValidPtr((void*)itemTemplate))
						continue;
					uint64_t pItemIdStr3 = mem->Read<uint64_t>(itemTemplate + 0x50);
					if (!IsValidPtr((void*)pItemIdStr3))
						continue;
					int32_t iddLength3 = mem->Read<int32_t>(pItemIdStr3 + 0x10);
					std::wstring idd3 = mem->GetUnicodeString(pItemIdStr3 + 0x14, iddLength3);
					std::string name(idd3.begin(), idd3.end());
					bool quest = mem->Read<bool>(itemTemplate + 0x94);
					std::unordered_map<std::string, std::pair<std::string, int>>::const_iterator got = SDK::Instance()->AllItems.find(name);
					if (got == SDK::Instance()->AllItems.end())
					{
						ItemInstance.name = name;
					}
					else
					{
						ItemInstance.name = got->second.first;
						ItemInstance.price = got->second.second;
					}

					std::unordered_map<std::string, bool>::const_iterator got1 = SDK::Instance()->filteredItems.find(name);
					if (got1 != SDK::Instance()->filteredItems.end())
					{
						if (got1->second)
							ItemInstance.showAlways = true;
						else
							ItemInstance.showAlways = false;
					}

					ItemInstance.quest = quest;
					if (quest && Config::esp::Items::quest)
						ItemInstance.price = 9999999;
					else if (quest && !Config::esp::Items::quest)
						ItemInstance.price = -9999999;
					ItemInstance.idd = idd3;
					ItemInstance.pos = pos;
					ItemInstance.pTransform = TransformGood;

					Vector3 itemPos = { 0, 0, 0 };
					FVector localPosF = SDK::Instance()->localPlayer.head;
					Vector3 localPos = { localPosF.x, localPosF.y, localPosF.z };

					ItemInstance.visible = true;

					container_items.emplace_back(ItemInstance);
				}
				ContainerInstance.pos = pos;
				ContainerInstance.items = container_items;
				container_local.push_back(ContainerInstance);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			// get position
			uint64_t TransformOne = mem->Read<uint64_t>(gameObject + 0x30);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)TransformOne))
				continue;

			uint64_t TransformTwo = mem->Read<uint64_t>(TransformOne + 0x8);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)TransformTwo))
				continue;

			uint64_t TransformGood = mem->Read<uint64_t>(TransformTwo + 0x38);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)TransformGood))
				continue;

			FVector pos = mem->Read<FVector>(TransformGood + 0x90);

			// get itemTemplate
			uint64_t itemTemplate = mem->Read<uint64_t>(Item + 0x40);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)itemTemplate))
				continue;

			// get item id
			uint64_t pItemIdStr = mem->Read<uint64_t>(itemTemplate + 0x50);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)pItemIdStr))
				continue;

			int32_t iddLength3 = mem->Read<int32_t>(pItemIdStr + 0x10);
			std::wstring idd3 = mem->GetUnicodeString(pItemIdStr + 0x14, iddLength3);
			bool quest = mem->Read<bool>(itemTemplate + 0x94);
			std::string id(idd3.begin(), idd3.end());

			if (id == skCrypt("55d7217a4bdc2d86028b456d").decrypt())
			{
				CorpseInstance.pos = pos;
				//CorpseInstance.side = GetCorpseType(ite);
				//CorpseInstance.aggressorSide = GetLastAggressorSide(ite);
				//CorpseInstance.name = GetCorpseName(ite);
				CorpseInstance.instance = ite;
				//CorpseInstance.items = PlayerInv(ite, false);
				//CorpseInstance.weaponName = GetCorpseWeapon(ite);
				corpse_local.emplace_back(CorpseInstance);
			}
			else if (id != "")
			{
				std::unordered_map<std::string, std::pair<std::string, int>>::const_iterator got = SDK::Instance()->AllItems.find(id);
				if (got == SDK::Instance()->AllItems.end())
				{
					ItemInstance.name = id;
				}
				else
				{
					ItemInstance.name = got->second.first;
					ItemInstance.price = got->second.second;
				}

				std::unordered_map<std::string, bool>::const_iterator got1 = SDK::Instance()->filteredItems.find(id);
				if (got1 != SDK::Instance()->filteredItems.end())
				{
					if (got1->second)
						ItemInstance.showAlways = true;
					else
						ItemInstance.showAlways = false;
				}

				ItemInstance.itemPtr = Item;
				ItemInstance.quest = quest;
				if (quest && Config::esp::Items::quest)
					ItemInstance.price = 9999999;
				else if (quest && !Config::esp::Items::quest)
					ItemInstance.price = -9999999;
				ItemInstance.idd = idd3;
				ItemInstance.pos = pos;
				ItemInstance.pTransform = TransformGood;
				//Vector3 itemPos = { pos.x, pos.y, pos.z };
				//printf("%i\n", Visible(itemPos, { 0, 0, 0 }));

				items_local.emplace_back(ItemInstance);
			}
		}
	}

	SDK::Instance()->mutex1.lock();

	SDK::Instance()->containers = container_local;
	SDK::Instance()->items = items_local;
	SDK::Instance()->corpses = corpse_local;

	SDK::Instance()->mutex1.unlock();

	return true;
}

bool DiscoverPlayers(uint64_t gameWorld)
{
	std::vector<EFTPlayer> players_local;

	uint64_t onlineusers = mem->Read<uint64_t>(gameWorld + 0x80);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)onlineusers))
		return false;

	uint64_t list_base = mem->Read<uint64_t>(onlineusers + 0x10);
	if (!IsValidPtr((void*)list_base))
		return false;

	int player_count = mem->Read<int>(onlineusers + 0x18);
	if (player_count == 0)
		return false;

	int i2 = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < player_count; i++)
	{
		auto pPlayer = *(uint64_t*)(list_base + 0x20 + (i * 0x8)); // Player pointer
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)pPlayer))
			continue;

		EFTPlayer player;

		player.instance = pPlayer;

		player.weapon = GetPlayerWeaponID(player.instance);
		player.type = GetEntityType(player.instance);
		player.name = PlayerName(player.instance);

		if (player.type == 664) // if is a pmc
		{
			player.level = GetPlayerLevel(player.instance);
			player.group = GetPlayerGroup(player.instance);
			player.side = GetSideName(GetSide(player.instance));
		}

		player.lootList = PlayerInv(player.instance, true);
		//player.ammocount = ammocount(player.instance);

		player.head = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanHead));
		player.neck = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanNeck));

		player.rupperarm = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanRUpperarm));
		player.rforearm = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanRForearm1));
		player.rpalm = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanRPalm));

		player.lupperarm = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanLUpperarm));
		player.lforearm = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanLForearm1));
		player.lpalm = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanLPalm));

		player.spine1 = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanSpine1));
		player.pelvis = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanPelvis));

		player.lthigh = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanLThigh1));
		player.lcalf = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanLCalf));
		player.lfoot = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanLFoot));

		player.rthigh = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanRThigh1));
		player.rcalf = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanRCalf));
		player.rfoot = Position(GetTransform(mem, player.instance, Bones::HumanRFoot));

		player.location = player.head;

		player.bonesHealth = GetHealth(player.instance);

		player.KDRatio = floorf(GetPlayerKD(player.instance) * 100) / 100;

		Vector3 itemPos = { player.head.x, player.head.y, player.head.z };
		FVector localPosF = SDK::Instance()->localPlayer.head;
		Vector3 localPos = { localPosF.x, localPosF.y, localPosF.z };

		player.visible = Visible(itemPos, localPos);

		if (mem->Read<int>(player.instance + 0x7FF))
		{
			SDK::Instance()->mutex1.lock();
			SDK::Instance()->localPlayer = player;

			uint64_t handsController = mem->Read<uint64_t>(player.instance + 0x510);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)handsController))
				continue;

			uint64_t fireportPointer = mem->Read<uint64_t>(handsController + 0x20);
			if (!IsValidPtr((void*)fireportPointer))
				continue;

			SDK::Instance()->localPlayer.Fireport = Position(fireportPointer);
			SDK::Instance()->mutex1.unlock();

			players_local.emplace_back(player);

			continue;
		}
		else
		{

			for (auto vec : player.bonesHealth)
			{
				player.health.x += vec.x;
				player.health.y += vec.y;
			}

			if (player.health.x > 0)
			{
				players_local.emplace_back(player);
			}
			continue;
		}
	}

	SDK::Instance()->mutex1.lock();
	SDK::Instance()->players = players_local;
	SDK::Instance()->mutex1.unlock();

	return true;
}

uint64_t GetObjectFromList(Memory* drvHandler, uint64_t listPtr, uint64_t lastObjectPtr, const char* objectName)
{
	struct BaseObject
	{
		uint64_t previousObjectLink; //0x0000
		uint64_t nextObjectLink; //0x0008
		uint64_t object; //0x0010
	};

	__try
	{
		char name[256];
		uint64_t classNamePtr = 0x0;

		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)listPtr))
			return 0;

		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)lastObjectPtr))
			return 0;

		BaseObject activeObject = *reinterpret_cast<BaseObject*>(listPtr);
		BaseObject lastObject = *reinterpret_cast<BaseObject*>(lastObjectPtr);

		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)lastObject.object))
			return 0;

		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)lastObject.previousObjectLink))
			return 0;

		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)lastObject.nextObjectLink))
			return 0;

		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)activeObject.object))
			return 0;

		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)activeObject.previousObjectLink))
			return 0;

		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)activeObject.nextObjectLink))
			return 0;

		int x = 0;
		if (activeObject.object != 0x0)
		{
			while (IsValidPtr((void*)activeObject.object) && activeObject.object != lastObject.object)
			{
				x++;

				if (x > 5000)
					break;

				if (!IsValidPtr((void*)activeObject.object))
					continue;

				classNamePtr = drvHandler->Read<uint64_t>(activeObject.object + 0x60);
				if (!IsValidPtr((void*)classNamePtr))
					continue;

				safe_memcpy(&name, (void*)(classNamePtr + 0x0), 256);
				if (strcmp(name, objectName) == 0)
				{
					return activeObject.object;
				}

				if (activeObject.object == lastObject.object)
					break;

				activeObject = drvHandler->Read<BaseObject>(activeObject.nextObjectLink + 0x0);

				if (!IsValidPtr((void*)activeObject.object))
					return 0;

				if (!IsValidPtr((void*)activeObject.previousObjectLink))
					return 0;

				if (!IsValidPtr((void*)activeObject.nextObjectLink))
					return 0;
			}
		}
		if (lastObject.object != 0x0)
		{
			if (lastObject.object != NULL)
			{
				classNamePtr = drvHandler->Read<uint64_t>(lastObject.object + 0x60);
				if (!IsValidPtr((void*)classNamePtr))
					return 0;

				safe_memcpy(&name, (void*)(classNamePtr + 0x0), 256);
				if (strcmp(name, objectName) == 0)
				{
					return lastObject.object;
				}
			}
		}

		return 0;
	}
	__except (EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
		return 0;
	}
}

void __stdcall impl::hooks::hk_gui_controller_start(void* instance)
{
	return;
}

static bool wakeup{ true };
void __stdcall  impl::hooks::hk_gui_controller_update(void* instance)
{
	if (!wakeup)
	{
		auto PreloaderPtr = mono_lib::method("EFT.UI", "PreloaderUI", "Update");
		if (PreloaderPtr)
		{
			printf("1 - %i\n", MH_CreateHook((void*)PreloaderPtr, hkpreloader_ui_update_fn, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&oPreloader)));
			printf("1 - %i\n", MH_EnableHook((void*)PreloaderPtr));
		}

		MONO_OBFUSCATED_METHOD(fovPtr, "Assembly-CSharp", "\\uE771", "SetFov", void*);
		if (fovPtr)
		{
			printf("2 - %i\n", MH_CreateHook((void*)fovPtr, hkset_fov, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&oSetFov)));
			printf("2 - %i\n", MH_EnableHook((void*)fovPtr));
		}

		auto skinnedPtr = mono_lib::method("Diz.Skinning", "Skin", "get_SkinnedMeshRenderer");
		if (skinnedPtr)
		{
			printf("3 - %i\n", MH_CreateHook((void*)skinnedPtr, hkget_skinned_mesh_renderer, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&oSkinnedMesh)));
			printf("3 - %i\n", MH_EnableHook((void*)skinnedPtr));
		}

		//auto applyPtr = mono_lib::method("EFT", "NetworkPlayer", "ApplyTeleportPacket");
		//if (applyPtr)
		{
			//printf("4 - %i\n", MH_CreateHook((void*)applyPtr, hkApplyTeleport, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&oApplyTeleport)));
			//printf("4 - %i\n", MH_EnableHook((void*)applyPtr));
		}

		wakeup = true;
	}

	return;
}


static bool runDesync;
void __stdcall impl::hooks::hk_gui_controller_ongui(void* instance)
{
	if (c_events::get_current_event()->type() == event_type::repaint)
	{
		auto game_world = c_world::find_instance();
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)game_world))
			goto end;

		auto players = game_world->get_players();
		if (!IsValidPtr((void*)game_world))
			goto end;

		auto player_count = players->get_count();
		if (player_count <= 0 || player_count > 10000)
			goto end;

		EFTPlayer localPlayer;
		localPlayer.instance = players->get(0);

		static bool run = false;
		if (!run)
		{
			run = true;
			wakeup = false;
		}

		uint64_t tagged_objects[2];
		uint64_t gom = mem->Read<uint64_t>(m_unity_player + 0x17F8D28);

		tagged_objects[0] = mem->Read<uint64_t>(gom + offsetof(GameObjectManager, lastTaggedObject));
		tagged_objects[1] = mem->Read<uint64_t>(gom + offsetof(GameObjectManager, taggedObjects));

		SDK::Instance()->mutex1.lock();
		SDK::Instance()->offsets.fpsCamera = GetObjectFromList(mem, tagged_objects[1], tagged_objects[0], "FPS Camera");
		SDK::Instance()->mutex1.unlock();

		SDK::Instance()->ReadMatrix();
```

```h
#pragma once

#define CREATE_TYPE( name, args ) using mono_##name = args; inline mono_##name name;
#define ASSIGN_TYPE( name ) name = SAPPHIRE_TYPE( L"mono-2.0-bdwgc.dll", mono_##name );

#define MONO_OBFUSCATED_METHOD( fn_name, assembly, klass_name, method, args ) \
	static auto fn_name = reinterpret_cast< args >( mono_lib::get_obfuscated_method( mono_lib::get_obfuscated_class( assembly, klass_name ), method ) )

	inline void _cdecl enumerator(void* callback, std::vector<void*>* vec) // pushes back every assembly loaded, even ones outside of root domain
	{
		vec->push_back(callback);
	}

	inline auto get_obfuscated_class(const char* assembly_name, const char* klass_name) -> const std::uintptr_t
	{
		const auto assembly = domain_assembly_open(get_root_domain(), assembly_name);
		if (!assembly)
			return { };

		const auto img = assembly_get_image(std::uintptr_t(assembly));
		if (!img)
			return { };

		auto type_def = image_get_table_info(img, 2);
		if (!type_def)
			return { };

		auto type_def_count = table_info_get_rows(type_def);
		if (type_def_count <= 0)
			return { };

		for (int i = 0; i < type_def_count; i++)
		{
			auto this_class = class_get(img, 0x02000000 | i + 1);
			if (!this_class)
				continue;

			auto name = class_get_name(this_class);
			auto klass_namespace = class_get_namespace(this_class);

			if ((std::uint8_t)name[0] == 0xEE) {
				char name_buff[32];
				sprintf_s(name_buff, 32, "\\u%04X", chloe::crt::string::utf8_to_utf16((char*)name));
				name = name_buff;
			}

			if (chloe::crt::string::strcmp((char*)name, (char*)klass_name)) {
				return this_class;
			}
		}

		return { };
	}

	inline auto find_class(const char* klass_name, const char* name_space = "") -> const std::uintptr_t
	{
		const auto domain = get_root_domain();

		std::vector<void*> v;
		assembly_foreach(mono_lib::enumerator, &v);

		for (auto assembly : v)
		{
			if (!assembly)
				continue;

			const auto img = assembly_get_image(std::uintptr_t(assembly));
			if (!img)
				continue;

			const auto klass = class_from_name(img, name_space, klass_name);
			if (!klass)
				continue;

			return klass;
		}

		return {};
	}

	inline auto type_object(const char* name_space, const char* name) -> const std::uintptr_t
	{
		auto klass = find_class(name, name_space);
		return type_get_object(get_root_domain(), class_get_type(klass));
	}

	// im sorry this is messy but its a lot cleaner in the end.
	inline auto sanitize_method_name(const std::string name) -> const sanitized_method_t
	{
		std::string ns, kl, method_name;

		if (auto ns_break = name.find("::"))
			ns = name.substr(0, ns_break);

		if (name.find("::") == std::string::npos)
			ns = "";

		if (name.find("::")) {
			kl = name.substr(name.find("::", 2) + 2);
			kl = kl.substr(0, kl.find(".", 0));
		}

		if (name.find("::") == std::string::npos)
			kl = name.substr(0, name.find(".", 0));

		method_name = name.substr(name.find(".", 0) + 1);

		if (method_name.find("()"))
			method_name.erase(method_name.find("()"), 2);

		return { ns, kl, method_name };
	}

	inline auto method(const std::string name, int argument_number = -1) -> const std::uintptr_t {
		std::uintptr_t iter{};

		const auto st = sanitize_method_name(name);
		const auto klass = find_class(st.kl.c_str(), st.ns.c_str());
		if (!klass)
			return{ };

		const auto method = class_get_method_from_name(klass, st.mt.c_str(), argument_number);
		if (!method)
			return { };

		return compile_method(method);
	}

	inline auto get_obfuscated_method(const std::uintptr_t klass, const char* method_name) -> const std::uintptr_t
	{
		std::uintptr_t iter{};

		while (auto method = class_get_methods(klass, &iter))
		{
			auto name = method_get_name(method);

			if ((std::uint8_t)name[0] == 0xEE) {
				char name_buff[32];
				sprintf_s(name_buff, 32, "\\u%04X", chloe::crt::string::utf8_to_utf16((char*)name));
				name = name_buff;
			}

			if (chloe::crt::string::strcmp(name, method_name)) {
				return compile_method(method);
			}
		}

		return {};
	}

	inline auto method(const std::uintptr_t klass, const char* method_name, int argument_number = -1) -> const std::uintptr_t
	{
		const auto method = class_get_method_from_name(klass, method_name, argument_number);
		if (!method)
			return { };

		return compile_method(method);
	}

	inline auto method(const char* ns, const char* klass_name, const char* name, int argument_number = -1) -> const std::uintptr_t {
		std::uintptr_t iter{};

		const auto klass = find_class(klass_name, ns);
		if (!klass)
			return{ };

		const auto method = class_get_method_from_name(klass, name, argument_number);
		if (!method)
			return { };

		return compile_method(method);
	}

	inline auto arg_method(const std::string name, int argument_number = -1, const char* arg_name = "") -> const std::uintptr_t {
		std::uintptr_t iter{};

		const auto st = sanitize_method_name(name);
		const auto klass = find_class(st.kl.c_str(), st.ns.c_str());
		if (!klass)
			return{ };

		while (const auto method = class_get_methods(klass, &iter))
		{
			const auto signature = method_signature(method);
			if (!signature)
				continue;

			auto param_count = signature_get_param_count(signature);
			if (!param_count || param_count < argument_number || param_count > argument_number)
				continue;

			const char* _names[128] = { 0 };

			method_get_param_names(method, _names);

			for (int i = 0; i < param_count; i++)
			{
				if (_names[i])
				{
					if (chloe::crt::string::strcmp(_names[i], arg_name))
						return compile_method(method);
				}
			}

		}

		return { };
	}
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include "sapphire_crt.h"

#define SAPPHIRE_FUNC( mod, type ) reinterpret_cast< decltype( &type ) >( chloe::get_exported_function( chloe::get_sapphire_module( ##mod ), #type ) )

	inline auto get_sapphire_module(const wchar_t* name) -> const chloe::saph_module_t
	{

		const chloe::nt::peb* peb = reinterpret_cast<chloe::nt::peb*>(__readgsqword(0x60));
		if (!peb)
			return {}; // how the fuck did we even get here?

		const chloe::nt::list_entry head = peb->Ldr->InMemoryOrderModuleList;

		for (auto curr = head; curr.Flink != &peb->Ldr->InMemoryOrderModuleList; curr = *curr.Flink)
		{
			chloe::nt::ldr_data_table_entry* mod = reinterpret_cast<chloe::nt::ldr_data_table_entry*>(contains_record(curr.Flink, chloe::nt::ldr_data_table_entry, InMemoryOrderLinks));

			if (mod->BaseDllName.Buffer)
			{
				if (chloe::crt::string::wcsicmp_insensitive(mod->BaseDllName.Buffer, name))
				{
					return chloe::saph_module_t{ mod->DllBase, mod->BaseDllName.Buffer, mod->SizeOfImage };
				}
			}
		}

		return {};
	}

	inline auto get_exported_function(const chloe::saph_module_t module, const char* function) -> const void*
	{
		if (!module.base)
			return {};

		const auto base = reinterpret_cast<std::uintptr_t>(module.base);
		const chloe::nt::image_dos_header* dos_header = reinterpret_cast<chloe::nt::image_dos_header*>(base);
		const chloe::nt::image_nt_headers* nt_header = reinterpret_cast<chloe::nt::image_nt_headers*>(base + dos_header->e_lfanew);

		const chloe::nt::image_data_directory* data_directory = reinterpret_cast<const chloe::nt::image_data_directory*>(&nt_header->OptionalHeader.DataDirectory[0]);
		const chloe::nt::image_export_directory* image_export_directory = reinterpret_cast<chloe::nt::image_export_directory*>(base + data_directory->VirtualAddress);

		const auto* const rva_table = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned long*>(base + image_export_directory->AddressOfFunctions);
		const auto* const ord_table = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned short*>(base + image_export_directory->AddressOfNameOrdinals);

		if (image_export_directory)
		{
			for (unsigned int idx{ 0 }; idx < image_export_directory->NumberOfNames; idx++)
			{
				const auto fn_name = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(base + reinterpret_cast<const unsigned long*>(base + image_export_directory->AddressOfNames)[idx]);

				if (chloe::crt::string::strcmp(fn_name, function))
					return reinterpret_cast<void*>(base + ((std::uint32_t*)(base + image_export_directory->AddressOfFunctions))[ord_table[idx]]);
			}
		}

		return { };
	}
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <codecvt>
#include <intrin.h>

#undef min
#undef max
#define max( a, b ) ( ( ( a ) > ( b ) ) ? ( a ) : ( b ) )
#define min( a, b ) ( ( ( a ) < ( b ) ) ? ( a ) : ( b ) )

namespace chloe
{
	namespace crt
	{
		namespace memory
		{
			inline void* memcpy(void* destination, const void* source, std::size_t size)
			{
				auto data_source = static_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(source);
				auto data_destination = static_cast<std::uint8_t*>(destination);

				__movsb(data_destination, data_source, size);
				return static_cast<void*>(data_destination);
			}
		}

		namespace string
		{
			inline unsigned int wcslen(const wchar_t* str)
			{
				int counter = 0;
				if (!str)
					return 0;
				for (; *str != '\0'; ++str)
					++counter;

				return counter;
			}

			inline bool wcsicmp(wchar_t* a, const wchar_t* b)
			{
				if (!a || !b)
					return !a && !b;

				int ret = 0;
				wchar_t* p1 = (wchar_t*)a;
				wchar_t* p2 = (wchar_t*)b;
				while (!(ret = *p1 - *p2) && *p2)
					++p1, ++p2;

				return ret == 0;
			}

			inline const char* strstr(const char* input, const char* find)
			{
				while (*(input++) != '\0') {
					const char* p, * q;
					for (p = input, q = find; *q != '\0' && *p == *q; p++, q++) {}
					if (*q == '\0') {
						return input;
					}
				}

				return 0;
			}

			inline int wcsicmp_insensitive(const wchar_t* cs, const wchar_t* ct)
			{
				const auto len = wcslen(cs);
				if (len != wcslen(ct))
					return false;

				for (size_t i{ 0 }; i < len; i++)
					if ((cs[i] | L' ') != (ct[i] | L' '))
						return false;

				return true;
			}

			inline unsigned short utf8_to_utf16(char* val) {
				std::wstring_convert<std::codecvt_utf8_utf16<char16_t>, char16_t> convert;
				std::u16string dest = convert.from_bytes(val);
				return *(unsigned short*)&dest[0];
			}

			inline bool strcmp(const char* a, const char* b)
			{
				if (!a || !b)
					return !a && !b;

				int ret = 0;
				unsigned char* p1 = (unsigned char*)a;
				unsigned char* p2 = (unsigned char*)b;
				while (!(ret = *p1 - *p2) && *p2)
					++p1, ++p2;

				return ret == 0;
			}
		}
	}
}

namespace managed_system
{
	template<typename type>
	class c_list {
	private:
		char pad_0x10[0x10];
		uintptr_t list_base;
		uint32_t count;
	public:
		int get_count() {
			if (!this || !list_base)
				return 0;

			return int(this->count);
		}

		type get(uint32_t index) {
			if (!this || !list_base)
				return type();
			return *reinterpret_cast<type*>(this->list_base + 0x20 + index * 0x8);
		}
	};

	class c_string
	{
	public:
		char zpad[0x10]{ };
		int size{ };
		wchar_t buffer[128 + 1];
	public:
		c_string(const wchar_t* st)
		{
			size = min(chloe::crt::string::wcslen(st), 128);
			for (size_t idx{ 0 }; idx < size; idx++)
				buffer[idx] = st[idx];

			buffer[size] = 0;
		}
	};
}
```

```cpp
    float clip(float n, float lower, float upper)
    {
        n = (n > lower) * n + !(n > lower) * lower;
        return (n < upper) * n + !(n < upper) * upper;
    }

    bool Checkbox(const char* label, bool* v)
    {
        ImGuiWindow* window = GetCurrentWindow();
        if (window->SkipItems)
            return false;

        ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
        const ImGuiStyle& style = g.Style;
        const ImGuiID id = window->GetID(label);
        const ImVec2 label_size = CalcTextSize(label, NULL, true);

        const ImRect check_bb(ImVec2(window->DC.CursorPos.x + 247, window->DC.CursorPos.y), ImVec2(window->DC.CursorPos.x + 255, window->DC.CursorPos.y) + ImVec2(label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2, label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2)); // We want a square shape to we use Y twice
        ItemSize(check_bb, style.FramePadding.y);

        ImRect total_bb = check_bb;
        if (label_size.x > 0)
            SameLine(0, style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        const ImRect text_bb(window->DC.CursorPos + ImVec2(0, style.FramePadding.y), window->DC.CursorPos + ImVec2(0, style.FramePadding.y) + label_size);
        if (label_size.x > 0)
        {
            ItemSize(ImVec2(text_bb.GetWidth(), check_bb.GetHeight()), style.FramePadding.y);
            total_bb = ImRect(ImMin(check_bb.Min, text_bb.Min), ImMax(check_bb.Max, text_bb.Max));
        }

        if (!ItemAdd(total_bb, id))
            return false;

        bool hovered, held;
        bool pressed = ButtonBehavior(ImRect(ImVec2(total_bb.Min.x - 14.f + 227, total_bb.Min.y), ImVec2(total_bb.Max.x, total_bb.Max.y)), id, &hovered, &held);
        if (pressed)
            *v = !(*v);

        float Alpha = alpha[id / 1000000];
        //RenderNavHighlight(total_bb, id);
        RenderFrame(ImVec2(check_bb.Min.x, check_bb.Min.y + 5.f), ImVec2(check_bb.Max.x, check_bb.Max.y - 5.f), *v ? ImColor(0.00, 0.48, 0.63, opacityMain / 255.f) : ImColor(37 / 255.f, 37 / 255.f, 37 / 255.f, (float)opacityMain / 255.f), true, 16);

        float fade = 8.333 * ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime;

        if (*v)
        {
            if (Alpha <= 1.f)
            {
                Alpha += fade;
                alpha[id / 1000000] = Alpha;  // done on 2 hours of sleep please dont judge xD
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (Alpha >= 0.f)
            {
                Alpha -= fade;
                alpha[id / 1000000] = Alpha; // done on 2 hours of sleep please dont judge xD
            }
        }


        const float check_sz = ImMin(check_bb.GetWidth(), check_bb.GetHeight());
        const float pad = ImMax(1.0f, (float)(int)(check_sz / 6.0f));
        //window->DrawList->AddRectFilled(check_bb.Min + ImVec2(2.f, 2.f), check_bb.Max - ImVec2(2.f, 2.f), ImColor(1.00f, 0.00f, 0.00f, Alpha), 2.f); // Main gradient.

        if (*v)
        {
            window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(check_bb.Max.x - 4.f, check_bb.Min.y + 10.5f), 8.f, ImColor(0, 186, 231, opacityMain), 255.f);
        }
        else
        {
            window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(check_bb.Min.x + 4.f, check_bb.Min.y + 10.5f), 8.f, ImColor(102, 102, 102, opacityMain), 255.f);
        }

        if (label_size.x > 0.0f)
            RenderText(ImVec2(text_bb.Min.x - 22.f, text_bb.Min.y), label);

        return pressed;
    }

    float radioAlpha[99999] = { };
    bool RadioButton(const char* label, bool active)
    {
        ImGuiWindow* window = GetCurrentWindow();
        if (window->SkipItems)
            return false;

        ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
        const ImGuiStyle& style = g.Style;
        const ImGuiID id = window->GetID(label);
        const ImVec2 label_size = CalcTextSize(label, NULL, true);

        const ImRect check_bb(window->DC.CursorPos, window->DC.CursorPos + ImVec2(label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2 - 1, label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2 - 1));
        ItemSize(check_bb, style.FramePadding.y);

        ImRect total_bb = check_bb;
        if (label_size.x > 0)
            SameLine(0, style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        const ImRect text_bb(window->DC.CursorPos + ImVec2(0, style.FramePadding.y), window->DC.CursorPos + ImVec2(0, style.FramePadding.y) + label_size);
        if (label_size.x > 0)
        {
            ItemSize(ImVec2(text_bb.GetWidth(), check_bb.GetHeight()), style.FramePadding.y);
            total_bb.Add(text_bb);
        }

        if (!ItemAdd(total_bb, id))
            return false;

        ImVec2 center = check_bb.GetCenter();
        center.x = (float)(int)center.x + 0.5f;
        center.y = (float)(int)center.y + 0.5f;
        const float radius = check_bb.GetHeight() * 0.5f;

        bool hovered, held;
        bool pressed = ButtonBehavior(total_bb, id, &hovered, &held);

        float Alpha = radioAlpha[id / 1000000];

        RenderNavHighlight(total_bb, id);
        window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(center, radius, GetColorU32((held && hovered) ? ImGuiCol_FrameBgActive : hovered ? ImGuiCol_FrameBgHovered : ImGuiCol_FrameBg), 16);

        float fade = 8.333 * ImGui::GetIO().DeltaTime;
        if (active)
        {
            if (Alpha <= 1.f)
            {
                Alpha += fade;
                radioAlpha[id / 1000000] = Alpha; // done on 2 hours of sleep please dont judge xD
            }
        }
        else
        {
            if (Alpha >= 0.f)
            {
                Alpha -= fade;
                radioAlpha[id / 1000000] = Alpha; // done on 2 hours of sleep please dont judge xD
            }
        }

        const float check_sz = ImMin(check_bb.GetWidth(), check_bb.GetHeight());
        const float pad = ImMax(1.0f, (float)(int)(check_sz / 6.0f));
        window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(center, radius - pad, ImColor(1.00f, 0.00f, 0.00f, Alpha), 16);

        if (style.FrameBorderSize > 0.0f)
        {
            window->DrawList->AddCircle(center + ImVec2(1, 1), radius, GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_BorderShadow), 16, style.FrameBorderSize);
            window->DrawList->AddCircle(center, radius, GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Border), 16, style.FrameBorderSize);
        }

        if (label_size.x > 0.0f)
            RenderText(text_bb.Min, label);

        return pressed;
    }

    bool RadioButton(const char* label, int* v, int v_button)
    {
        const bool pressed = RadioButton(label, *v == v_button);
        if (pressed)
        {
            *v = v_button;
        }
        return pressed;
    }

    bool KeyPressed(int* key)
    {
        int i = 0;
        while (i < 256)
        {
            if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(i)) // Unsafe but works
            {
                *key = i;
                return true;
            }
            i++;
        }
        return false;
    }

    bool HotkeyButtonEx(const char* label, int* key, const ImVec2& size_arg, ImGuiButtonFlags flags)
    {
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ItemSpacing, ImVec2(0, 2));
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, 2));
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();
        ImGui::SetCursorPosX(10.f);
        std::string name = label;
        ImGui::Text(name.c_str());
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::SetCursorPosX(150);
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FrameRounding, 4.f);
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_WindowBg, ImVec4(0.015, 0.015, 0.015, 0));
        ImGuiIO io = ImGui::GetIO();
        if (ImGui::Button(KeyNames[*key], ImVec2(130, 20.f)))
        {
            while (true)
            {
                Sleep(1);
                if (!io.MouseDown[0]) // fucking dumb way to wait until button is no longer pressed but it works. Fix soon.
                    break;
            }
            *key = 0;
        }
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();
        ImGui::PopStyleColor();
        if (*key == 0)
            KeyPressed(key);
        return true;
    }

    bool HotkeyButton(const char* label, int* key, const ImVec2& size_arg)
    {
        return HotkeyButtonEx(label, key, size_arg, 0);
    }

    const char* PatchFormatStringFloatToInt(const char* fmt)
    {
        if (fmt[0] == '%' && fmt[1] == '.' && fmt[2] == '0' && fmt[3] == 'f' && fmt[4] == 0) // Fast legacy path for "%.0f" which is expected to be the most common case.
            return "%d";
        const char* fmt_start = ImParseFormatFindStart(fmt);    // Find % (if any, and ignore %%)
        const char* fmt_end = ImParseFormatFindEnd(fmt_start);  // Find end of format specifier, which itself is an exercise of confidence/recklessness (because snprintf is dependent on libc or user).
        if (fmt_end > fmt_start && fmt_end[-1] == 'f')
        {
#ifndef IMGUI_DISABLE_OBSOLETE_FUNCTIONS
            if (fmt_start == fmt && fmt_end[0] == 0)
                return "%d";
            ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
            ImFormatString(g.TempBuffer, IM_ARRAYSIZE(g.TempBuffer), "%.*s%%d%s", (int)(fmt_start - fmt), fmt, fmt_end); // Honor leading and trailing decorations, but lose alignment/precision.
            return g.TempBuffer;
#else
            IM_ASSERT(0 && "DragInt(): Invalid format string!"); // Old versions used a default parameter of "%.0f", please replace with e.g. "%d"
#endif
        }
        return fmt;
    }

    bool SliderScalar(const char* label, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_data, const void* p_min, const void* p_max, const char* format, ImGuiSliderFlags flags)
    {
        ImGuiWindow* window = GetCurrentWindow();
        if (window->SkipItems)
            return false;

        ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
        const ImGuiStyle& style = g.Style;
        const ImGuiID id = window->GetID(label);
        const float w = CalcItemWidth();

        const ImVec2 label_size = CalcTextSize(label, NULL, true);
        const ImRect frame_bb(ImVec2(window->DC.CursorPos.x + 120.f, window->DC.CursorPos.y), window->DC.CursorPos + ImVec2(w + 70.f, label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f));
        const ImRect total_bb(frame_bb.Min, frame_bb.Max + ImVec2(0.0f, 0.0f));

        const bool temp_input_allowed = (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoInput) == 0;
        ItemSize(total_bb, style.FramePadding.y);
        if (!ItemAdd(total_bb, id, &frame_bb, temp_input_allowed ? ImGuiItemFlags_Inputable : 0))
            return false;

        // Default format string when passing NULL
        if (format == NULL)
            format = DataTypeGetInfo(data_type)->PrintFmt;
        else if (data_type == ImGuiDataType_S32 && strcmp(format, "%d") != 0) // (FIXME-LEGACY: Patch old "%.0f" format string to use "%d", read function more details.)
            format = PatchFormatStringFloatToInt(format);

        // Tabbing or CTRL-clicking on Slider turns it into an input box
        const bool hovered = ItemHoverable(frame_bb, id);
        bool temp_input_is_active = temp_input_allowed && TempInputIsActive(id);
        if (!temp_input_is_active)
        {
            const bool input_requested_by_tabbing = temp_input_allowed && (g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_FocusedByTabbing) != 0;
            const bool clicked = (hovered && g.IO.MouseClicked[0]);
            if (input_requested_by_tabbing || clicked || g.NavActivateId == id || g.NavActivateInputId == id)
            {
                SetActiveID(id, window);
                SetFocusID(id, window);
                FocusWindow(window);
                g.ActiveIdUsingNavDirMask |= (1 << ImGuiDir_Left) | (1 << ImGuiDir_Right);
                if (temp_input_allowed && (input_requested_by_tabbing || (clicked && g.IO.KeyCtrl) || g.NavActivateInputId == id))
                    temp_input_is_active = true;
            }
        }

        if (temp_input_is_active)
        {
            // Only clamp CTRL+Click input when ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp is set
            const bool is_clamp_input = (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp) != 0;
            return TempInputScalar(frame_bb, id, label, data_type, p_data, format, is_clamp_input ? p_min : NULL, is_clamp_input ? p_max : NULL);
        }

        // Slider behavior
        ImRect grab_bb;
        const bool value_changed = SliderBehavior(ImRect(ImVec2(frame_bb.Min.x, frame_bb.Min.y), ImVec2(frame_bb.Max.x - 10.f, frame_bb.Max.y)), id, data_type, p_data, p_min, p_max, format, flags, &grab_bb);
        if (value_changed)
            MarkItemEdited(id);

        RenderFrame(ImVec2(frame_bb.Min.x, frame_bb.Min.y + 9.f), ImVec2(grab_bb.Min.x + 5.f, frame_bb.Max.y - 9.f), ImGui::GetColorU32(ImVec4(0.00, 0.48, 0.63, opacityMain / 255.f)), true, g.Style.FrameRounding);

        RenderFrame(ImVec2(grab_bb.Min.x + 5.f, frame_bb.Min.y + 9.f), ImVec2(frame_bb.Max.x - 10.f, frame_bb.Max.y - 9.f), ImGui::GetColorU32(ImVec4(0.16, 0.16, 0.16, opacityMain / 255.f)), true, g.Style.FrameRounding);

        // Render grab
        if (grab_bb.Max.x > grab_bb.Min.x)
            window->DrawList->AddCircleFilled(ImVec2(grab_bb.Min.x + 5.f, grab_bb.Min.y + 8.5f), 7.f, ImColor(0, 186, 231, opacityMain), 255);

        // Display value using user-provided display format so user can add prefix/suffix/decorations to the value.
        char value_buf[64];
        const char* value_buf_end = value_buf + DataTypeFormatString(value_buf, IM_ARRAYSIZE(value_buf), data_type, p_data, format);
        if (g.LogEnabled)
            LogSetNextTextDecoration("{", "}");


        //RenderTextClipped(frame_bb.Min, frame_bb.Max, value_buf, value_buf_end, NULL, ImVec2(0.5f, 0.5f));

        RenderText(ImVec2(frame_bb.Max.x, frame_bb.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y / 2 + 2.f), std::to_string((int)(*(const float*)p_data)).c_str());

        if (label_size.x > 0.0f)
            RenderText(ImVec2(frame_bb.Min.x - 110.f, frame_bb.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y / 2 + 2.f), label);

        IMGUI_TEST_ENGINE_ITEM_INFO(id, label, g.LastItemData.StatusFlags);
        return value_changed;
    }

    bool SliderFloat(const char* label, float* v, float v_min, float v_max, const char* format, ImGuiSliderFlags flags)
    {
        return SliderScalar(label, ImGuiDataType_Float, v, &v_min, &v_max, format, flags);
    }

    bool Items_SingleStringGetter(void* data, int idx, const char** out_text)
    {
        const char* items_separated_by_zeros = (const char*)data;
        int items_count = 0;
        const char* p = items_separated_by_zeros;
        while (*p)
        {
            if (idx == items_count)
                break;
            p += strlen(p) + 1;
            items_count++;
        }
        if (!*p)
            return false;
        if (out_text)
            *out_text = p;
        return true;
    }

    static float CalcMaxPopupHeightFromItemCount(int items_count)
    {
        ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
        if (items_count <= 0)
            return FLT_MAX;
        return (g.FontSize + g.Style.ItemSpacing.y) * items_count - g.Style.ItemSpacing.y + (g.Style.WindowPadding.y * 2);
    }

    bool BeginCombo(const char* label, const char* preview_value, ImGuiComboFlags flags)
    {
        ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
        ImGuiWindow* window = GetCurrentWindow();

        ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags backup_next_window_data_flags = g.NextWindowData.Flags;
        g.NextWindowData.ClearFlags(); // We behave like Begin() and need to consume those values
        if (window->SkipItems)
            return false;

        const ImGuiStyle& style = g.Style;
        const ImGuiID id = window->GetID(label);
        IM_ASSERT((flags & (ImGuiComboFlags_NoArrowButton | ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview)) != (ImGuiComboFlags_NoArrowButton | ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview)); // Can't use both flags together

        const float arrow_size = (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoArrowButton) ? 0.0f : GetFrameHeight();
        const ImVec2 label_size = CalcTextSize(label, NULL, true);
        const float w = (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview) ? arrow_size : CalcItemWidth();
        const ImRect bb(ImVec2(window->DC.CursorPos.x + 150.f, window->DC.CursorPos.y), ImVec2(window->DC.CursorPos.x + 150.f + 130.f, window->DC.CursorPos.y + ImVec2(w, label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f).y));
        const ImRect total_bb(bb.Min, bb.Max + ImVec2(label_size.x > 0.0f ? style.ItemInnerSpacing.x + label_size.x : 0.0f, 0.0f));
        ItemSize(total_bb, style.FramePadding.y);
        if (!ItemAdd(total_bb, id, &bb))
            return false;

        // Open on click
        bool hovered, held;
        bool pressed = ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held);
        const ImGuiID popup_id = ImHashStr("##ComboPopup", 0, id);
        bool popup_open = IsPopupOpen(popup_id, ImGuiPopupFlags_None);
        if (pressed && !popup_open)
        {
            OpenPopupEx(popup_id, ImGuiPopupFlags_None);
            popup_open = true;
        }
        //RenderFrame(bb.Min, bb.Max, ImColor(37 / 255.f, 37 / 255.f, 37 / 255.f, (float)opacityMain / 255.f), true, style.FrameRounding);
        //window->DrawList->AddRect(bb.Min, bb.Max, ImColor(0.15, 0.15, 0.15, opacityMain / 255.f), style.FrameRounding, 0, 1.f);
        // Render shape
        const float value_x2 = ImMax(bb.Min.x, bb.Max.x);
        RenderNavHighlight(bb, id);
        if (!(flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview))
        {
            window->DrawList->AddRectFilled(bb.Min, ImVec2(value_x2, bb.Max.y), ImColor(0.015, 0.015, 0.015, (float)opacityMain / 255.f), style.FrameRounding);
        }
        if (!(flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoArrowButton))
        {
            ImU32 bg_col = GetColorU32((popup_open || hovered) ? ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered : ImGuiCol_Button);
            ImU32 text_col = GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text);
            //window->DrawList->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(value_x2, bb.Min.y), bb.Max, bg_col, style.FrameRounding, (w <= arrow_size) ? ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersAll : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersRight);
            if (value_x2 + arrow_size - style.FramePadding.x <= bb.Max.x)
                RenderArrow(window->DrawList, ImVec2(bb.Max.x - arrow_size + style.FramePadding.y, bb.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y), text_col, ImGuiDir_Down, 1.0f);
        }
        RenderFrameBorder(bb.Min, bb.Max, style.FrameRounding);

        // Custom preview
        if (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_CustomPreview)
        {
            g.ComboPreviewData.PreviewRect = ImRect(bb.Min.x, bb.Min.y, value_x2, bb.Max.y);
            IM_ASSERT(preview_value == NULL || preview_value[0] == 0);
            preview_value = NULL;
        }

        // Render preview and label
        if (preview_value != NULL && !(flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview))
        {
            if (g.LogEnabled)
                LogSetNextTextDecoration("{", "}");
            RenderTextClipped(bb.Min + style.FramePadding, ImVec2(value_x2, bb.Max.y), preview_value, NULL, NULL);
        }
        if (label_size.x > 0)
            RenderText(ImVec2(bb.Min.x - 140.f, bb.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y), label);

        window->DrawList->AddRectFilled(ImVec2(bb.Max.x - 21.f, bb.Min.y), ImVec2(bb.Max.x, bb.Max.y), ImColor(0.015, 0.015, 0.015, (float)opacityMain / 255.f), style.FrameRounding);
        window->DrawList->AddLine(ImVec2(bb.Max.x - 15.f, bb.Min.y + 8.5f), ImVec2(bb.Max.x - 12.f, bb.Min.y + 11.5f), ImColor(255, 255, 255, opacityMain), 1.2f);
        window->DrawList->AddLine(ImVec2(bb.Max.x - 12.f, bb.Min.y + 11.5f), ImVec2(bb.Max.x - 9.f, bb.Min.y + 8.5f), ImColor(255, 255, 255, opacityMain), 1.2f);
        window->DrawList->AddRect(bb.Min, bb.Max, ImColor(0.15, 0.15, 0.15, opacityMain / 255.f), style.FrameRounding, 0, 1.2f);

        if (!popup_open)
            return false;

        g.NextWindowData.Flags = backup_next_window_data_flags;
        return BeginComboPopup(popup_id, bb, flags);
    }

    bool Combo(const char* label, int* current_item, bool (*items_getter)(void*, int, const char**), void* data, int items_count, int popup_max_height_in_items)
    {
        ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;

        // Call the getter to obtain the preview string which is a parameter to BeginCombo()
        const char* preview_value = NULL;
        if (*current_item >= 0 && *current_item < items_count)
            items_getter(data, *current_item, &preview_value);

        // The old Combo() API exposed "popup_max_height_in_items". The new more general BeginCombo() API doesn't have/need it, but we emulate it here.
        if (popup_max_height_in_items != -1 && !(g.NextWindowData.Flags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasSizeConstraint))
            SetNextWindowSizeConstraints(ImVec2(0, 0), ImVec2(FLT_MAX, CalcMaxPopupHeightFromItemCount(popup_max_height_in_items)));

        if (!BeginCombo(label, preview_value, ImGuiComboFlags_None))
            return false;

        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ItemSpacing, ImVec2(0, 1));
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, 2));
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();

        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ItemSpacing, ImVec2(0, 2));

        // Display items
        // FIXME-OPT: Use clipper (but we need to disable it on the appearing frame to make sure our call to SetItemDefaultFocus() is processed)
        bool value_changed = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < items_count; i++)
        {
            PushID(i);
            const bool item_selected = (i == *current_item);
            const char* item_text;
            if (!items_getter(data, i, &item_text))
                item_text = "*Unknown item*";
            if (Selectable(item_text, item_selected))
            {
                value_changed = true;
                *current_item = i;
            }
            if (item_selected)
                SetItemDefaultFocus();
            PopID();
        }

        ImGui::PopStyleVar();

        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ItemSpacing, ImVec2(0, 1));
        ImGui::Dummy(ImVec2(0, 2));
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();

        EndCombo();

        if (value_changed)
            MarkItemEdited(g.LastItemData.ID);

        return value_changed;
    }

    bool Combo(const char* label, int* current_item, const char* items_separated_by_zeros, int height_in_items)
    {
        ImGui::PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_FrameRounding, 4.f);
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_PopupBg, ImVec4(37 / 255.f, 37 / 255.f, 37 / 255.f, (float)opacityMain / 255.f));
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Header, ImVec4(37 / 255.f, 37 / 255.f, 37 / 255.f, (float)opacityMain / 255.f));
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_HeaderActive, ImVec4(37 / 255.f, 37 / 255.f, 37 / 255.f, (float)opacityMain / 255.f));
        ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_HeaderHovered, ImVec4(0.15, 0.15, 0.15, opacityMain / 255.f));
        int items_count = 0;
        const char* p = items_separated_by_zeros;
        while (*p)
        {
            p += strlen(p) + 1;
            items_count++;
        }
        bool value_changed = Combo(label, current_item, Items_SingleStringGetter, (void*)items_separated_by_zeros, items_count, height_in_items);
        ImGui::PopStyleColor(4);
        ImGui::PopStyleVar();
        return value_changed;
    }

    bool ButtonEx(const char* icon, const char* label, const ImVec2& size_arg, const ImVec2& offset, bool border, ImVec4 col, ImVec4 bordercol, ImGuiButtonFlags flags)
    {
        ImGuiWindow* window = GetCurrentWindow();
        if (window->SkipItems)
            return false;

        ImGuiContext& g = *GImGui;
        const ImGuiStyle& style = g.Style;
        const ImGuiID id = window->GetID(label);
        const ImVec2 label_size = CalcTextSize(label, NULL, true);

        ImVec2 pos = window->DC.CursorPos;
        if ((flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_AlignTextBaseLine) && style.FramePadding.y < window->DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset) // Try to vertically align buttons that are smaller/have no padding so that text baseline matches (bit hacky, since it shouldn't be a flag)
            pos.y += window->DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset - style.FramePadding.y;
        ImVec2 size = CalcItemSize(size_arg, label_size.x + style.FramePadding.x * 2.0f, label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f);

        const ImRect bb(pos, pos + size);
        ItemSize(size, style.FramePadding.y);
        if (!ItemAdd(bb, id))
            return false;

        if (g.LastItemData.InFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_ButtonRepeat)
            flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_Repeat;

        bool hovered, held;
        bool pressed = ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held, flags);

        const ImU32 bg_col = GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_WindowBg);
        ImVec4 color = ImGui::ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(bg_col);

        // Render
        RenderNavHighlight(bb, id);
        //ImGui::PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Border, ImVec4(0.66, 0.15, 0.15, opacityMain / 255.f));
        RenderFrame(bb.Min, bb.Max, ImColor(col.x, col.y, col.z, (float)opacityMain / 255.f), true, style.FrameRounding);

        if (border)
            window->DrawList->AddRect(bb.Min, bb.Max, ImColor(bordercol.x, bordercol.y, bordercol.z, opacityMain / 255.f), style.FrameRounding, 0, 1.2f);
        //ImGui::PopStyleColor();

        if (g.LogEnabled)
            LogSetNextTextDecoration("[", "]");

        ImVec2 pos2 = (bb.Max - bb.Min) / 3;
        ImVec2 pos3 = (bb.Max - bb.Min) / 2;

        ImGui::PushFont(eltardo);
        RenderTextClipped(ImVec2(pos2.x + bb.Min.x, bb.Min.y), bb.Max - style.FramePadding, label, NULL, &label_size, ImVec2(0.5, 0.5), &bb); //style.ButtonTextAlign
        ImGui::PopFont();

        ImGui::PushFont(logo2);
        RenderTextClipped(ImVec2(bb.Min.x + offset.x, bb.Min.y + offset.y), ImVec2(pos3.x + bb.Min.x + offset.x, bb.Max.y + offset.y), icon, NULL, &label_size, ImVec2(0.5, 0.5), &bb); //style.ButtonTextAlign
        ImGui::PopFont();

        //RenderTextClipped(bb.Min + style.FramePadding, bb.Max - style.FramePadding, label, NULL, &label_size, ImVec2(0, 0.5), &bb); //style.ButtonTextAlign

        // Automatically close popups
        //if (pressed && !(flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_DontClosePopups) && (window->Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup))
        //    CloseCurrentPopup();

        IMGUI_TEST_ENGINE_ITEM_INFO(id, label, g.LastItemData.StatusFlags);
        return pressed;
    }

    bool Button(const char* icon, const char* label, const ImVec2& size_arg, const ImVec2& offset, bool border, ImVec4 col, ImVec4 bordercol)
    {
        return ButtonEx(icon, label, size_arg, offset, border, col, bordercol, ImGuiButtonFlags_None);
    }
}
```
